title: Flipkart-owned fashion e-commerce giant Myntra’s FY26 financials: How falling logistics income dragged revenue down
summary: Myntra’s operating revenue declined in FY26 as logistics revenue fell 53.2% to ₹1,119.2 crore, outweighing modest marketplace growth and a 35.2% rise in advertising income.
